note: First-pass numbers chosen by the assistant on 2026-11-14. None has been tuned with players. Version 3: the second decision is a call to Trauma Team (ids still say 'refer'); a call on a steady patient now costs the call-out (false_call). Agent limits were raised for typed and spoken conversation: 16 patient-model calls per visit, a 4 s wait, replies asked to stay within 110 characters and shown up to 220 (two pages of the strip); the proxy must hold the same numbers. Push-to-talk (agent.voice): a clip is at most 10 s, 24 clips per visit, 7 s to wait for its words; quieter than silence_peak is not sent. Version 4 (2026-11-15, after the student's eleven notes): the flat rent became an hourly line (line.per_hour: one visit is one hour, the meter is read after each, and the last reading decides the night); a patient whose patience reaches 0 waits patience.leave_ms and then leaves unpaid and unbilled (outcome gave_up); the counter glass takes attack.glass blows per shift, attack.blow_at places them inside window_ms, and with less glass left the patient comes through sooner, never sooner than attack.min_window_ms. Version 5 (2026-11-16, after the student's notes on the screen and the glass): between patients the doctor can pay attack.repair_cost credits for one layer of the counter glass. It takes one more blow, and an empty frame has a pane again. The money leaves the till at once and the meter counts it at every later reading. No other number changed. Version 6 (2026-11-17, after the student's notes on clarity, CALM, sudden rage and the new story: the doctor, fired by Kessler and in debt, fronts a Lantern street clinic and passes contraband chrome): contacts (the night's couriers, data/contacts.json) pay contacts.pay for a drop and a wrong code costs contacts.wrong_cost patience; the line doubles to 240 an hour, so right calls alone (1140) no longer hold it and at least one drop is needed; CALM is a calm-patch from the drawer that costs reassure.cost credits a use; a drifting patient may snap mid-exam (snap: no chance for the first snap.grace actions, then snap.step more per action, up to snap.max) and any patient may flare once a visit (flare: a shout and a hand on the glass, no attack, evidence for TEMPER only). Neither happens on the training visit. Every other number is unchanged. Version 7 (2026-11-18, after the student asked for reference sheets by implant model): the grip limit left the rules for the spec binder (data/parts.json): each hands model has its own limit_ms (natural 1000 as before, LOADER 1500, DEFT 500, REFLEX 300, SEAM 800), and the sheet and the close-up show the patient's. No other number changed. Version 8 (2026-11-18, after the student asked that right and wrong be told only at the end of the night, and that a doctor who is killed ends the night): the slip says only what happened at the counter, in words that hold whoever the patient was (counter), and what came in there: the fee for work done, whoever the patient was, the drop, less CALM. Whether each call was right, Trauma Team's bounties and bills and the bill for work on a patient who drifted (scoring, which takes the fee back as well) come in at closing, before the last reading; the readings on the way count the counter money only. A patient who gets through the window kills the doctor: the night ends there, the rest of the hall goes home unseen, and the title is LIGHTS OUT (titles died, line_text died); nobody reads the meter in the hour it happened, and the night does not hold the line. RIGHT THE HARD WAY, a night of right calls that still hurt you, can no longer happen and was removed. No number changed. Version 9 (2026-11-18, after the student asked that any part of any character can be the broken one, with fixed test nights besides): each night draws who comes in from roster, who of them drifts and which sign each sheet row shows (night; cases/<id>.json lists every character's normal and broken signs, data/nights.json the test nights). With the visitors and the truths drawn, the old money no longer held: a night with one drifting visitor paid four fees and held the line without a drop, a night with three fell far short. So Trauma Team now pays a drifting patient's fee as its bounty (scoring.refer_drifting is added on top, 0), a night of right calls brings in exactly the night's fees whoever drifted, and the visitors are drawn so their fees come under the line and within one drop of it; the line is 400 an hour (2000 a night) to fit five fees. Night A, the night as written, has fees of 1900, as before 60 under the line in the old money. Trauma Team pays the fee on account when it takes somebody, at the counter, and its report at closing keeps it or takes it back with the call-out: a bounty paid only at closing left a night of right calls under the line at most readings. No other number changed. Version 10 (2026-11-20, after the student's play): the push that breaks a patient (the second PRESS, the last entry of a case's press list) takes every lamp left, so the bar is empty when a steady patient walks out or a drifting one lunges (VisitState.press_cost()); in version 9 it took costs.press like the first, and a patient could walk out with lamps still lit. Nothing during the night says which visitor carried an entry of tonight's list that was not picked up: the list stamps only PICKED UP and the slip names no alias; the closing report still says which visit missed its drop. The aliases and codes are drawn per night (contacts.json version 2). No number changed. Version 13: each visitor has two lamps. Talk is free. Physical tests and PRESS spend one lamp, as does a wrong courier code. BREAK is free when temper was tested or the lamps ran out. Complaints guide the choice of tests.
shift_order_note: The visitors of test night A in the order they come (data/nights.json A must list them so): the night a test or a capture builds when it names nobody. A played night is drawn (night) unless a test night is asked for.

night.note: Draw the roster, drift and signs with the night seed. Wear and complaints use independent streams. The opening visitor is steady and unworn on the first night.

line.note: What Harrow Credit's meter wants in the till at each hourly reading: hour n needs n x per_hour. Five hours make 2000. A night of right calls brings in the night's fees (a steady patient pays at the counter; Trauma Team pays the fee of anyone it takes on account, keeps it as the bounty for a drifting one and takes it back for a steady one at closing), and night.fees_under_line draws visitors whose fees come under 2000 but within one drop of it, so the night is held only with at least one contact's drop (contacts.pay). The readings before the last are warnings and count only what came in at the counter (fees, drops, less CALM and glass), so a treat and a call read the same through the night; the last one is taken at closing, with every visit's money in, and decides the night.

patience.note: The visitor leaves after this much idle counter time with no lamp.

contacts.note: Two fair couriers. A matching code is free and a wrong code takes one lamp. Training teaches the second visitor.

snap.note: Only a first-time test or PRESS rolls. Talk, codes and reopens are safe.

flare.note: Anyone may flare, at most once a visit, from the action after grace on: a shout and a hand slammed on the glass. It is never an attack: no red bar, nothing to stop, nothing scored. Its note goes on the TEMPER line and agrees with the case (face and voice together, or not). A snap that comes up wins over a flare.

attack.note: blow_at: when each blow lands on the glass, as a share of window_ms. A blow that lands before the shutter is down costs one of the glass points. With g points left only g blows land and the patient comes through at the time of the next one (1800, 1440, 990 ms, then min_window_ms). repair_cost: what one point costs to put back, between patients; 0 switches repairs off. At 40 a whole pane (three layers) costs 120, under a third of an hour of the line at 400 an hour (version 9; it was half an hour at 240).

scoring.note: In all (version 9): a drifting patient handed over, or caught at the shutter, brings Trauma Team's bounty, the patient's fee plus refer_drifting; the crew pays the fee on account at the counter and refer_drifting comes at closing. Work on a drifting patient takes the fee back and costs treat_drifting more. false_call: the call-out for a steady patient, whose fee Trauma Team takes back at closing. false_alarm: a shutter dropped on a steady patient. hit: a patient who came through the window. A drifting patient shut out before any attack (locked_out) pays nothing.

agent.languages_note: A hanzi takes the room of two letters on the strip: Chinese gets half the characters. The same numbers are in agent_proxy/src/core.mjs DEFAULT_LIMITS.languages.

titles_note: The first entry that fits is used. died, where an entry has it, must equal whether the night ended with the doctor killed, so LIGHTS OUT comes first. min_correct counts right calls (out of five). max_injuries is optional. line_held, where an entry has it, must equal the night's last meter reading: a night that ended under the line is THE CUT whatever else went right, and a night that hurt you is not given a title that says it went well.

titles.title: LIGHTS OUT
titles.last_visitor_text: The shutter came too late. Trauma Team found you on the clinic floor.
titles.text: The shutter came too late. Trauma Team found you on the clinic floor. Whoever was still waiting in the hall went home unseen.

titles.title: THE CUT
titles.text: Under the line at closing. Harrow Credit sends two quiet people to collect on the debt. They start with the hands.

titles.title: STEADY HANDS
titles.text: Five patients, five right calls. The sheet goes back on its nail. You open again tomorrow.

titles.title: A GOOD NIGHT'S WORK
titles.text: One visit went wrong. Most nights are like that. The rest went the way they should.

titles.title: OPEN, BARELY
titles.text: You were right more often than not. In this trade that is not the same as safe.

titles.title: ON NOTICE
titles.text: The line held, and that is the kindest thing to say. The Lanterns noticed the rest. The sheet was on the wall the whole time.

line_text.held: Meter: OVER THE LINE. The debt waits another night.
line_text.short: Meter: UNDER THE LINE. The debt is called in.
line_text.died: Nobody reads the meter tonight. Harrow Credit takes the clinic back.

counter_note: What the slip says at the counter, by what was done: words that hold whoever the patient was, so the slip gives nothing away. {name} is the patient's name. Whether it was right comes at closing, on the report. Since version 9 Trauma Team pays the fee of anyone it takes on account, so the money at the counter says nothing either.

treated.title: TREATED
treated.text: {name} pays the fee and goes through to the chair. Whether the work holds, you will hear at closing.

referred.title: HANDED OVER
referred.text: The crew takes {name} away and pays the fee on account. Their report comes at closing: if {name} was steady, they take it back and bill the call-out.

caught.title: SHUTTER HELD
caught.text: The shutter held, and Trauma Team came for {name}. They pay the fee on account; their report comes at closing.

shutter.title: SHUTTER DOWN
shutter.text: You dropped the shutter on {name}. No fee, no call. Whether it had to come down, you will know at closing.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Pushed too hard, {name} walks out. No fee, no call.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: {name} got tired of waiting and left. No fee, no call.
